target: Creality K2 Pro CFS cfs0_050_G32 / cfs0_000_153

setup.sampling: Moonraker box status and printhead filament sensor, approximately 0.25 s resolution

telemetry_limit: Encoder position remains unchanged in per-poll CFS snapshots during a load/unload, so the time of actual encoder onset was not independently measured. 'feeding_to_printhead' is an application phase marker, not a direct encoder signal. One sample per configuration, so timing jitter/repeatability are not statistically characterized.

important_bug.symptom: After a physical load/unload cycle, CONFIG_V2_SET and CONFIG_V2_RESET return 'rejected while stock CFS task is busy' even though box.state is IDLE, loaded_slot=-1 and printhead sensor false
important_bug.observed_after: stock cycle and both changed-parameter cycles
important_bug.implication: Cannot change or clear volatile runtime parameter until true MCU power cycle; host-side IDLE does not match firmware-side write guard.
important_bug.safety_action: Did not bypass busy guard, performed controlled T113 MCU rail cycles to clear volatile overrides; verified default values after each recovery.

recommendations: Keep v3.20 PR draft and do not declare release stable.
Investigate firmware SET/RESET busy guard transition across real load/unload; compare internal task-state byte after boot vs after load and select a safety-verified idle predicate.
Expose high-rate encoder samples or firmware phase events for precise encoder-to-printhead-sensor latency measurement.
Repeat baseline / ID7 / ID8 at least three times after the guard fix; speed experiments require activating separate controlled motor-speed hooks.
